papers.title_en: LocoMuJoCo: A Comprehensive Imitation Learning Benchmark for Whole-Body Control
papers.authors: Firas Al-Hafez, Davide Tateo, Oleg Kaidanov, Aditya Bhatt, Artur Zelik, Zhengyi Luo, Jan Peters
papers.evidence: 基于MuJoCo的人形全身控制基准
papers.tldr: 针对全身控制中模仿学习与强化学习缺乏统一评测的问题，LocoMuJoCo提供开源基准，以单一API整合MuJoCo CPU与MJX/MjWarp GPU后端。它涵盖9个人形、3个（肌）骨骼和4个四足本体，并为每个人形提供原生动捕数据，还可重定向AMASS与LAFAN1。模块化插件支持观测、奖励、控制模式、地形和域随机化互换，JAX算法实现JIT端到端训练。该工作降低复现与迁移门槛，并配套实机部署仓库，以MIT协议开放。
papers.abstract_en: LocoMuJoCo is an open-source benchmark for imitation learning (IL) and reinforcement learning (RL) on whole-body control. The library couples MuJoCo (CPU) with MJX and the MjWarp backend (GPU) under a single API, exposes 9 humanoid, 3 (musculo-)skeletal, and 4 quadruped embodiments, and ships a curated native motion-capture dataset for every humanoid, to which it can also retarget AMASS and LAFAN1. A modular plug-in architecture makes observations, rewards, control modes, terrains, and domain randomization fully interchangeable, while compact JAX implementations of many RL and IL algorithms provide JIT-compiled end-to-end training, and the companion loco-mujoco-real repository provides sim-to-real deployment. We describe the design, the SMPL-to-robot and robot-to-robot retargeting pipeline, and a usage example. LocoMuJoCo is released under MIT at https://github.com/robfiras/loco-mujoco.

papers.title_en: A Sequential Quadratic Programming Perspective on Optimal Control
papers.authors: Abhijeet, Suman Chakravorty
papers.evidence: 用SQP统一iLQR、DDP与牛顿法的最优控制求解
papers.tldr: 最优控制中 iLQR、DDP 与牛顿法关系长期缺乏统一解释。本文以序列二次规划（SQP）框架统一三者，并提出基于 Riccati 方程的 Newton-LQR 以求解精确牛顿步。分析表明 iLQR 是合理的修正 SQP 方法并能产生下降方向，而 DDP 与 Newton-LQR 引入动力学 Hessian 后可能需正则化。六个基准实验显示 iLQR 初期收敛常更优，Newton-LQR 与 DDP 在解附近可利用二阶信息加速收敛。
papers.abstract_en: This paper investigates the relationship between the iterative Linear Quadratic Regulator (iLQR), Differential Dynamic Programming (DDP), and Newton's method for optimal control problems. Using a unified Sequential Quadratic Programming (SQP) framework, we introduce Newton-LQR, a Riccati-based algorithm that solves for the exact Newton step the optimal control problem. Within this framework, we establish that iLQR is a principled modified SQP method rather than merely an approximation of DDP. We show that iLQR generates a descent direction, whereas the inclusion of dynamics Hessians in DDP and Newton-LQR may lead to indefinite quadratic subproblems and necessitate regularization. We further distinguish DDP and the proposed Newton-LQR algorithm through their treatment of costate information and second-order dynamics terms. Numerical experiments across six benchmark problems demonstrate that iLQR often exhibits superior convergence during the initial optimization phase, while Newton-LQR and DDP can exploit second-order information to accelerate convergence near a solution.

papers.title_en: Learning a Whole-Body Pivot-Walking Gait for Heavy-Box Transport with a Humanoid
papers.authors: Rikuto Hidaka, Tsung-Yuan Chen, Kento Kawaharazuka
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人旋转行走与平衡的单一强化学习策略
papers.tldr: 针对人形机器人搬运过重箱体时难以抬起的问题，本文提出单一强化学习策略，将迈步、平衡与物体操作联合协调。训练中用交替枢轴运动奖励和随物体位移推进的相位参考引导学习，并在部署时微调为不依赖物体状态的周期时钟版本。仿真中机器人可枢轴转动箱体，实物五次试验均将箱体向前搬运超过1米。结果表明，协调式人形枢轴行走可被强化学习并迁移到真实机器人。
papers.abstract_en: Through pivot walking, humans can transport objects that are too heavy to lift. Previous humanoid studies have relied on planned sequences in which object manipulation and stepping are executed separately and the object is brought to rest between successive rotations. However, few studies have developed a single learned controller for humanoid pivot walking. In this paper, we propose a single reinforcement-learning policy that jointly coordinates stepping, balance control, and object manipulation. The policy is trained using rewards that promote alternating pivot motions and a phase reference that progresses according to the displacement of the object. In simulation, we confirmed that the humanoid can pivot a box. For deployment, we fine-tuned the policy into an object-blind version that follows a periodic clock instead of the progress reference. On the real robot, the deployed policy transported the box forward by more than 1 m in all five trials; each trial ended at a base-tilt safety stop. These results demonstrate that coordinated humanoid pivot walking can be learned with reinforcement learning and transferred to a physical humanoid robot without direct object-state sensing.

papers.title_en: From Self-Play RL to Constrained Control: Distilling DiffMPC Students with DAgger
papers.authors: Luca M. Hartmann, Parinaz Naghizadeh
papers.evidence: 以可微MPC动作头施加硬约束并蒸馏进策略
papers.tldr: 自博弈强化学习能产出强驾驶策略，却难验证和解释；可微MPC虽能施加显式约束，却常依赖日志模仿或昂贵RL训练。作者保留PPO教师骨干，把动作头换成带道路边界和智能体椭圆约束的DiffMPC，并在自博弈模拟器用DAgger蒸馏学生。9个种子下，较小教师的学生在nuPlan追平教师，在CARLA和分布外Waymo反超；更强教师的学生在nuPlan与Waymo失败更少、CARLA持平，蒸馏耗时不超过教师训练30%。
papers.abstract_en: Self-play reinforcement learning (RL) produces strong driving policies, but these policies are hard to verify or interpret. Differentiable model predictive control (DiffMPC) can enforce explicit constraints, but it is usually trained by imitating logged data or with costly RL. To add constraints to an already trained policy, we keep a PPO teacher's backbone and replace its action head with a DiffMPC that enforces road boundary half-planes and agent ellipses. We then distill the student with DAgger in the teacher's self-play simulator. Over 9 seeds, the constrained student of a smaller teacher matches its teacher on nuPlan and beats it on CARLA and on out-of-distribution Waymo scenes. For a stronger teacher, the student has fewer failures on nuPlan and Waymo, while staying level on CARLA. Its distillation takes no more than 30% of the teacher's training time.

papers.title_en: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Qianzhong Chen, Muyuan Lin, Yuyin Sun, Mac Schwager, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.evidence: 在视频世界模型中用闭环强化学习后训练全身人形机器人VLA
papers.tldr: 人形全身VLA用强化学习提升受限于真实探索不安全与仿真残差。WEVO无需遥操作，在动作条件视频世界模型中后训练VLA，并用少量真实rollout对齐部署观测。三任务真机实验中，视频世界模型RL将平均成功率从23.3%提至75.0%，高于真实RL的48.3%。该框架结合仿真初始化覆盖与部署对齐世界模型，实现安全高效的全身体操作策略优化。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

papers.title_en: MixReact: Physics-Based Reactive Humanoid Control from Multimodal Cues via a Discrete-Continuous Mixture of Transformers
papers.authors: Bin Li, Xing Zhu, Jingya Wang
papers.evidence: 基于混合Transformer的物理化人形反应控制
papers.tldr: 现有线索驱动的人形反应生成方法支持的模态有限，且仅做纯运动学生成，容易出现物理伪影。MixReact 提出首个统一框架，可从文本、音频和视频线索驱动基于物理的人形反应控制：由 DisCo-MoT 预测下一状态，再由 HAT 输出可执行动作。在三种模态上，该方法在保真度、多样性与物理一致性上均优于基线。这为多模态物理人形反应控制提供了统一范式。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/

papers.title_en: SPRUNN: Structural Proximity for Pruning in Deep Neural Networks
papers.authors: Babak Rokha, Ali Azarpeyvanda, Alireza Khanteymoori, Tara Ghasempouri
papers.evidence: 用于高效深度网络实现的卷积滤波器剪枝
papers.tldr: 深度神经网络精度高但参数量与计算量大，剪枝的关键是选出合适参数而不显著损伤精度。SPRUNN 面向卷积层滤波器剪枝，利用结构邻近性计算每个滤波器与其他滤波器的相似度，识别冗余滤波器。方法还结合全连接层细粒度剪枝，并在重训练阶段引入学习率精调策略。实验表明其在多种架构和数据集上实现高压缩率且保持较高精度。
papers.abstract_en: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. Furthermore, we integrate this approach with fine-grained pruning in Fully Connected(FC)layerstocompresstheDNNsthatinclude both convolutional and FC layers.Toenhancetheaccuracyoftheprunedmodel,weproposealearning rate refinement strategy during the retraining phase. Experimental results demonstrate that SPRUNN achieves significant compression with high accuracy across diverse architectures and datasets.

papers.title_en: DynaMimic: A Physics-Informed World Model for Humanoid Motion Tracking
papers.authors: Chaoyue Xing, Linyi Huang, Yiting He, Yixuan Yin, Siqi Hou, Yi Zhang, Liyuan Pan, Miaomiao Liu, Daqi Liu
papers.evidence: 面向人形运动跟踪的物理信息世界模型
papers.tldr: 全身动作跟踪让人形机器人复现人类技能，但现有无模型强化学习要么蒸馏牺牲性能，要么依赖大规模算力；SuperMimic的隐式世界模型在支撑切换时误差易累积。DynaMimic将共享物理显式引入可微世界模型，预测各候选支撑连杆的接触力旋量与残余广义力，再用闭式拉格朗日正动力学计算下一状态。在60个LAFAN1动作上MPJPE较SuperMimic降低18.6%，地形跟踪亦提升，并在真实A3人形上完成倒地恢复、侧手翻和箱体跨越。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body motion tracking enables humanoid robots to reproduce diverse skills from human demonstrations. Existing model-free reinforcement learning methods either distill motion specialists into a single policy at the cost of performance or train a generalist policy directly using cluster-scale computation. SuperMimic reduces this computational cost through a differentiable world model that implicitly learns the physics shared across motions by predicting the next state from the current state and action. However, this implicit formulation may not fully capture the underlying physical processes. Errors around changes of support can accumulate over imagined rollouts used to train the tracking policy. To address this challenge, we introduce DynaMimic, a differentiable world model that explicitly incorporates shared physics into state prediction. Specifically, its network predicts a contact wrench at each candidate support link and a residual generalized force. DynaMimic then uses these predictions to compute the next state through closed-form Lagrangian forward dynamics. Across 60 full LAFAN1 motions, DynaMimic reduces mean per-joint position error (MPJPE) by 18.6% relative to SuperMimic. For terrain tracking, we give both methods the same local height maps. Relative to terrain-conditioned SuperMimic, DynaMimic reduces MPJPE by 14.9% on A3 Parkour (66.15 to 56.28~mm) and by 10.8% on GRAIL terrain clips (141.88 to 126.57~mm). On a real A3 humanoid, the learned policies can perform diverse skills, such as floor recovery, cartwheel and a box vault.

papers.title_en: $μ$MPC: Microsecond-Scale Nonlinear and World Model Control from Edge to GPU via Koopman-Linearized Precompilation
papers.authors: Devesh Nath, Glen Chou
papers.evidence: 将Koopman线性化MPC编译为仅含动作变量的二次规划以实现快速机器人控制
papers.tldr: 针对非线性MPC在线计算昂贵的问题，μMPC利用Koopman线性化动力学预计算有限时域控制到输出映射，消除提升状态轨迹，形成仅含动作变量的KC-QP。固定预计算原始算子使原对偶迭代只需矩阵向量乘与投影，可适应变化目标与约束而无需重构。桌面CPU求解低至23μs，Crazyflie上24ms，并在四足、视觉规划与多无人机场景显著加速。该工作实现了微秒级控制、世界模型规划与可微控制感知学习。
papers.abstract_en: We present $μ$MPC, a fast model predictive control (MPC) framework that reduces online computation using learned Koopman-linearized dynamics. By precomputing finite-horizon control-to-output maps, $μ$MPC eliminates lifted-state trajectories, yielding an action-only Koopman-Compiled QP (KC-QP) with $Hn_u$ decision variables, independent of lifted dimension. A fixed, precomputed primal operator enables efficient primal-dual iterations using only matrix-vector products and projections, accommodating changing goals and constraints without refactorization. This efficiency also enables control-aware dynamics learning through differentiable KC-QPs in the training loop and batched DAgger-style data aggregation. $μ$MPC achieves solve times as low as $23μ$s on a desktop CPU and 24 ms onboard a 168 MHz Crazyflie microcontroller. It scales to 4096D quadruped control in under 5 ms, visual planning with 2048D world models in 0.4 ms, and collision-aware planning for 200 quadrotors at over 30 Hz on the GPU. Across these benchmarks, $μ$MPC achieves up to $108\times$ faster constrained MPC and $1907\times$ faster visuomotor planning than competing methods.

papers.title_en: Into My Arms: Structured reinforcement learning for autonomous transport of objects and humans
papers.authors: Elle Miller, Reem Almheiri, Takuma Tsukakoshi, Ben Sanati, Tamon Miyake, Yushi Wang, Namiko Saito, Shigeki Sugano, Tetsuya Ogata, Rika Antonova, Oisin Mac Aodha, Sethu Vijayakumar
papers.evidence: 面向人形机器人全身操作与搬运的结构化强化学习
papers.tldr: 人形机器人全身操作受高维状态动作、接触丰富和长任务跨度三重瓶颈制约。为此，作者引入稀疏交互边SIE、交互门控搬运IGT和提示物体路径HOP，以结构化先验引导探索而不限制策略自主发现。实验实现医疗假人从床到轮椅的全自主转移，并用单一策略适应人体质量、尺寸和随机力扰动。该工作展示了纯强化学习驱动人形辅助搬运的可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body humanoid manipulation remains bottlenecked by high-dimensional state-action spaces, contact-rich environments, and long task horizons. This trilemma is a challenge that state-of-the-art reinforcement learning (RL) methods are yet to resolve reliably. We address it with three contributions that add just enough structure to guide exploration: Sparse Interaction Edges (SIE) for whole-body manipulation, Interaction Gated Transport (IGT) for sustained transport over long horizons, and a Hinted Object Path (HOP) that resolves collision and search complexity bottlenecks. Across all three, the policy remains free to discover its own manipulation strategy. The method generalises from rigid object to human transport. As a flagship demonstration, we show, to our knowledge, the first bed-to-wheelchair transfer of a medical mannequin by a humanoid robot completed with no human intervention during execution. In the domain of human transfer, we show that a single policy can adapt across substantial variations in body mass, size, and random force perturbations, all while training on a single GPU in under an hour. Our approach offers a pathway to fully RL-driven humanoid manipulation, enabling assistive robots that can help humans. Website: https://elle-miller.github.io/into_my_arms

papers.title_en: Motion Mamba 2.0: Autoregressive Diffusion Mamba for Long-Horizon Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Yue Huang, Tianshan Zhang, Zeyu Zhang, Jayeon Kang, Akide Liu, Sungjoon Choi, Dacheng Tao, Hao Tang
papers.evidence: 基于Mamba扩散架构的长时程人形运动生成
papers.tldr: 长时程实时人形控制要求兼顾远距历史与推理效率，现有自回归扩散受有界注意力缓存和重复去噪限制。Motion Mamba 2.0 用Mamba根-身体扩散架构融合局部注意力、可恢复循环状态与PCM，并配合CUDA Graph重放、融合核和执行流简化。HiPHI上实现39.52秒终端控制，RTX 4090中位延迟由1685.35降至276.14毫秒、约6.138倍加速，Unitree G1真机展示文本引导动作组合与交互运动。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, real-time controllable motion generation is essential for interactive animation and humanoid robotics, where an agent must respond to changing instructions and spatial goals while moving. Existing autoregressive diffusion methods generate motion incrementally, but bounded attention caches limit access to distant history, while repeated denoising introduces substantial inference overhead. We present Motion Mamba 2.0, a Mamba-based root-body diffusion architecture that integrates local attention, resumable recurrent states, and persistent content memory (PCM) for long-horizon controllable motion generation. PCM transforms compressed motion history from Mamba recurrent states, together with state changes and text-conditioned features, into dynamically updated content slots accessible to local attention. To enable efficient inference, we further develop an execution scheme tailored to this architecture, combining CUDA Graph replay, fused kernels, and execution-flow simplification while preserving the canonical history update. Evaluations on retargeted HiPHI demonstrate accurate terminal control over rollouts of up to 39.52 s, while short-horizon comparisons on BONES Seed and retargeted HumanML3D show that the model also retains strong spatial control and text-motion matching. On an RTX 4090, the optimized execution reduces median complete-window latency from 1685.35 to 276.14 ms, achieving a median paired speedup of 6.138$\times$ while preserving identical outputs and committed states in the tested rollouts. Moreover, we conduct extensive real-world evaluation on the Unitree G1, demonstrating sequential text-guided action composition, expressive motion, and interactive locomotion through keyboard and mouse control.

papers.title_en: Ada-BFM: Adapting Behavior Foundation Models for Humanoid Scene Interaction
papers.authors: Furui Xu, Weishuai Zeng, Zirui Wang, Kangning Yin, Jiacheng Bao, Huayi Wang, Yingying Qin, Yufei Xue, Yang Tang, Zenghao Tang, Kailin Li, Jingbo Wang, Weinan Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过后训练适配行为基础模型实现人形机器人全身场景交互
papers.tldr: 行为基础模型擅长全身控制，却难以直接迁移到需要几何约束与接触动力学的人形场景交互。Ada-BFM提出后训练框架，在预训练BFM上加入轻量适配器，实现交互特化调整并保留原有控制能力。每个交互域共享一个模型，而非逐任务训练控制器，支持地形与物体交互等多样任务。仿真和真机实验显示其加速学习、生成多样交互行为，并基本保持预训练行为水平。
papers.abstract_en: Behavior Foundation Models (BFMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose humanoid control through pretraining on large-scale behavioral data. However, their proficiency in whole-body coordination does not readily extend to scene interaction, which requires adapting motion to scene-dependent geometric constraints and contact dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce Ada-BFM, a post-training framework that adapts pretrained BFMs for humanoid scene interaction. Ada-BFM augments the original architecture with a lightweight adapter, enabling interaction-specific adjustments while leveraging pretrained control capabilities. Rather than producing a separate controller for each task, the framework yields a shared model for each interaction domain, supporting diverse tasks involving terrain or object interaction. Extensive experiments in simulation and the real world demonstrate that Ada-BFM enables diverse scene interaction behaviors, accelerates learning compared with training from scratch, and largely preserves pretrained behavioral competence. These findings establish Ada-BFM as an effective and efficient approach to extending the capabilities of BFMs beyond their pretraining settings while retaining their strengths in general whole-body control.

papers.title_en: MIFLOW: Dynamic Recent-Behavior Priors for Reference-Calibrated Online Flow-Policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Chenhao Wang, Haonan Ma, Wenjie Zhang, Yifan Wang, Mingbin Gao, Yuan-Ye Zhang, Wenjing Hong
papers.evidence: 在线actor-critic流策略学习与校准的价值引导更新
papers.tldr: 在线actor-critic中，离策略价值估计在低覆盖动作区不可靠，表达力强的流策略可能把概率质量移向critic偏好动作。MIFLOW用拟合近期执行动作、随新近性自适应的流匹配先验，作为价值引导策略改进的移动密度参考。它在actor更新与critic目标中加入维度归一化对数密度修正，提高低密度动作成本但保留其可探索性。六个MuJoCo任务五随机种子下，MIFLOW平均回报具竞争力，部分任务后期回报更高；Walker2d-v4中低密度动作占比更低。
papers.abstract_en: Flow-based policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. In online actor-critic learning, off-policy value estimates can be unreliable in poorly covered action regions, where expressive policies may shift probability mass toward critic-favored actions. We propose MIFLOW, which calibrates online flow-policy learning with a recency-adaptive flow-matching prior fitted to recently executed actions. Inspired by canalization as a qualitative analogy for path-dependent stabilization, we use the prior as a moving density reference for value-guided policy improvement. MIFLOW uses the approximate recent-action log-density in a dimension-normalized correction to both actor updates and critic targets. This correction increases the cost of low-density actions while keeping them available. Across six MuJoCo continuous-control tasks and five random seeds, MIFLOW achieves competitive mean return curves and higher late-training mean returns than the evaluated baselines on several tasks. In a Walker2d-v4 case study, MIFLOW shows a lower proportion of actions assigned low density by the learned reference, both overall and among high-Q actions. Prior-family and prior-buffer comparisons show task-dependent differences in returns and prior-defined diagnostics. These results support dynamic recent-behavior priors for reference calibration in the evaluated settings. The diagnostics measure how sampled actions align with the learned reference. True action support and critic extrapolation error remain unmeasured in these experiments.

papers.title_en: Can AI Design a Better nnU-Net? A Hypothesis-Driven Architecture Discovery Loop from Failures to Design Rules
papers.authors: Songtao Jiang, Yuan Wang, Fucheng Niu, Hualiang Wang, Jian Wu, Zuozhu Liu
papers.evidence: 假设驱动的神经架构搜索，提炼设计规则
papers.tldr: 现有神经架构搜索常以标量分数筛选设计，丢弃能解释成败的失败信息。作者让LLM智能体诊断结构化错误、提出可证伪假设，并在冻结nnU-Net流程下做反事实控制，把验证机制蒸馏为触发-动作规则。八轮搜索得到两条3D医学分割原则，产出LeanNeXt与LeanNeXt+。前者以0.78 MACs取得+1.63 Dice，后者在15个CT/MRI设置均超nnU-Net。
papers.abstract_en: Neural architecture search and LLM-driven evolution often reduce evaluation to a scalar fitness score, discarding failures that could explain why designs succeed or fail. We present a hypothesis-driven architecture discovery loop in which LLM agents diagnose structured error patterns, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, test counterfactual controls under a frozen nnU-Net pipeline, and distill validated mechanisms into executable trigger-to-action rules. Across eight search waves, the loop identifies two principles for 3D medical image segmentation. First, reallocating computation from high-resolution decoders to the mid-encoder preserves thin-anatomy boundaries while reducing cost. Second, support-confined region contrast addresses errors between nested anatomical compartments, with anatomy-dependent triggers selecting when the rule applies. These principles produce LeanNeXt (0.78 MACs and 0.92 training-step time relative to nnU-Net; +1.63 Dice points on four-fold KiTS23 cross-validation) and trigger-routed LeanNeXt+. The latter improves all 15 evaluated CT/MRI settings over nnU-Net and exceeds the 3.3 larger ResEnc-M on 12 of 15 benchmarks at 0.30 its parameter count. Relative to random sampling, one-shot LLM generation, and score-selected agent search, the loop shows how failure analysis can yield reusable design rules across modalities.

papers.title_en: Action-Dependent Policies for Multi-Agent Linear Quadratic Regulation
papers.authors: Yongjie Liu, Gangshan Jing, Long Wang
papers.evidence: 多智能体LQR最优控制与动作依赖策略
papers.tldr: 多智能体LQR通常受网络拓扑约束，分布式反馈增益存在不可避免的次优性。本文引入动作依赖策略（ADP），让每个智能体的控制不仅依赖邻居状态，也依赖其他智能体控制输入，从而在保持分布式结构的同时扩大可行增益集，并在合适条件下表示集中式最优策略。针对ADP导致代价函数失去强制性、投影梯度流可能不收敛的问题，提出部分正则化形式并建立与标准多智能体LQR的联系。数值实验验证了ADP降低次优性的效果。
papers.abstract_en: The linear quadratic regulation (LQR) problem over a multi-agent system usually requires a distributed feedback gain that is structurally constrained by the network topology, incurring an inevitable suboptimality gap. Existing studies either identify conditions on the system and topology that enable convex relaxation or seek a stationary point via policy gradient algorithms. In this paper, we reduce the suboptimality gap by adopting action-dependent policies (ADPs), where the control input of each agent depends on not only states of neighbor agents, but also control inputs of some other agents. We show that although exhibiting a distributed structure, ADP can enlarge the feasible set of feedback gains and even represent centralized optimal policies under suitable conditions. However, this comes at the price of losing coercivity of the cost function and possible failure of convergence for the projected gradient flow (PGF). To overcome this difficulty, we propose a partially regularized formulation, which guarantees convergence of PGFs, and forges a connection between standard multi-agent LQR and its action-dependent counterpart. Sufficient conditions for local convergence to globally optimal policies under PGFs regardless of regularization are also established. Finally, numerical examples are presented to validate the performance of ADP.

papers.title_en: PGX: Physically Grounded Execution for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Kai Lu, Chenyang Ma, Ioannis Havoutis
papers.evidence: 面向长时程人形机器人移动操作的分层物理接地执行框架
papers.tldr: 长程人形机器人移动操作要求时序、技能切换与精度紧密配合，但现有单体VLA难以稳定执行。PGX将时序与精度控制卸载给两个免训练经典组件：谓词状态机管理任务推进与恢复，阶段VLA技能专注操作，世界坐标锁定维持空间一致性。在三个仿真任务和Unitree G1真机任务上，PGX改善了阶段推进并提升任务成功率。该框架让VLA专注阶段技能动力学，为长程人形移动操作提供可落地的执行方案。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

papers.title_en: Nearly Minimax-Optimal Sample Complexity of Natural Policy Gradient with a Matching Information-Theoretic Lower Bound
papers.authors: Asha Barua, Sajad Khodadadian
papers.evidence: 自然策略梯度的策略优化样本复杂度
papers.tldr: 本文研究自然策略梯度（NPG）需要多少采样转移才能学到近优策略。在表格型有限时域MDP、奖励已知且转移核未知、可通过生成模型查询的设定下，作者提出不估计转移概率的采样NPG，并采用反向扫描更新策略。在三种批大小与步长方案下，算法取得 O~(SAH^4/ε^2) 的末迭代样本复杂度。作者进一步给出 Ω(SAH^4/ε^2) 信息论下界，证明该 H^4 依赖在最坏情况下不可避免，表明直接策略优化可达统计极限。
papers.abstract_en: A fundamental question in reinforcement learning is how many sampled transitions are needed to learn a near-optimal policy, and whether direct policy optimization can attain this statistical limit. To answer this question, we consider natural policy gradient (NPG), a widely used policy optimization method. We study tabular finite-horizon Markov decision processes (MDPs) with known rewards and unknown horizon-dependent transition kernels, accessed through a generative model. Our sample-based NPG algorithms update the policy by backward sweeps and do not estimate transition probabilities. Under three different batch-size and step size schedules, we establish last-iterate guarantees with sample complexity $\widetilde O(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$, where $S$, $A$, and $H$ denote the number of states, the number of actions, and the horizon length, respectively. In this setting, horizon-dependent transition kernels contribute a factor of $H$ to our transition-query bound. Our information-theoretic lower bound of $Ω(SAH^4/\varepsilon^2)$ shows that the resulting $H^4$ dependence is unavoidable in the worst case, even for agents that select their queries adaptively. To the best of our knowledge, these are the first last-iterate guarantees for NPG whose sample complexity matches an information-theoretic lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Consequently, our results demonstrate that direct policy-space optimization through NPG can achieve the fundamental statistical limits of reinforcement learning while guaranteeing the performance of the final policy. Furthermore, for known kernels, we prove that exact NPG with a constant step size $η=1/H$ requires $Ω(H^2/\varepsilon)$ iterations in the worst case, matching the known upper bound for that step size.

papers.title_en: $ζ_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control
papers.authors: Yizhi Chen, Zhanxiang Cao, Yitong Wang, Junyu Liu, Hongchu Zeng, Xinyi Peng, Chuxuan Huang, Yicheng Su, Zihao Zhou, Shengcheng Fu, Haoyang Li, Liyun Yan, Tianyue Zhan, Jianming Ma, Yang Zhang, Keqi Zhu, Xiaxi Si, Jinming Yao, Qiao Sun, Shizeng Zhang, Jiangwei Zhong, Yue Gao
papers.evidence: 人形控制中场景与身体联合预见的世界动作模型
papers.tldr: 人形机器人交互不仅依赖视觉预判，也需感知自身关节响应；仅预测视觉或使用潜空间距离损失，难以直接监督动作响应。ζ0 将视觉-语言-动作策略扩展为世界动作模型，在共享潜表示中同时预判未来视觉特征与实测关节轨迹，并用教师参考响应和双响应迁移联合训练因果预测器。HumanoidArena 七任务平均成功率 63.6%/79.5%，较基座提升 18.8/9.0 点；六项真实任务达 78.3%/85.0%，显示联合场景与身体前瞻可增强人形控制。
papers.abstract_en: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot's body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $ζ_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. On seven HumanoidArena tasks, $ζ_0$ built on $Ψ_0$ and GR00T N1.7 reaches 63.6% and 79.5% mean success, 18.8 and 9.0 points above these bases. On six real-world tasks, it reaches 78.3% and 85.0%, gains of 16.7 and 10.0 points. On GR00T, its 79.5% tops all compared seven-task joint policies. Project page: https://chenyizhi123.github.io/zeta0-project/

papers.title_en: CarlHOI: Counterfactual Predictive Imagination for Generalizable Multi-Humanoid Object Interaction under Constrained Environments
papers.authors: Wenjie Lin, Jin Wei-Kocsis
papers.evidence: 多台人形机器人协同控制与反事实世界模型
papers.tldr: 多个人形团队协同搬运共享物体时，面对未见障碍常需绕行和调整队形，预训练协作策略难以直接适应。CarlHOI提出反事实预测想象框架，基于CarlWM将物体、人形与障碍建模为交互实体，离线推演不同路点命令下的集体未来，并按进度、失败、接触风险与长期价值选择引导指令。仅用4个人形训练，即可零重训泛化到2至10人团队、未见障碍与物体及新约束组合。在三个障碍搬运基准上成功率优于基线，为扩展预训练多智能体协作技能提供新思路。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in physics-based humanoid control enable teams of varying sizes to coordinate their movements and cooperatively transport shared objects. However, adapting learned cooperative behaviors to unseen environmental constraints remains challenging, particularly when obstacles require coordinated detours and changes in team configuration. We propose CarlHOI, a counterfactual predictive imagination framework built upon a counterfactual-anchored relational latent world model (CarlWM) for human-object interaction (HOI), enabling multi-humanoid teams to adapt to unseen environmental constraints without retraining their underlying cooperative control policies. CarlHOI explicitly represents the shared object, individual humanoids, and environmental obstacles as interacting entities. Trained offline using counterfactual simulator rollouts, the model imagines alternative collective futures under different shared waypoint commands, predicting how the coupled humanoid team and object would respond. By evaluating these imagined outcomes through predicted progress, failure, and contact risks, and long-horizon value estimates, CarlHOI selects adaptive guidance commands while preserving the pretrained cooperative controller. We introduce a benchmark comprising three challenging obstacle-constrained transport tasks to evaluate adaptation and generalization. Despite being trained exclusively with four humanoids, our model generalizes without retraining to teams of two to ten humanoids, unseen obstacle geometries and placements, unseen objects, and novel combinations of environmental constraints. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved cooperative transport success over evaluated baselines across diverse configurations. Results highlight the potential of counterfactual predictive imagination to extend pretrained multi-humanoid cooperative skills beyond their original training conditions.

papers.title_en: φTD: Distributional Reinforcement Learning using Characteristic Functions
papers.authors: Thomas Mousseau, Tyler Kastner, Davide Baldelli, Amir-massoud Farahmand
papers.evidence: 分布式强化学习学习回报分布与价值函数
papers.tldr: 分布强化学习旨在学习完整回报分布，但现有分位数与分类方法受限于较窄的分布族。φTD 将损失计算搬到频率域，用特征函数刻画回报分布，从而统一分位数与分类范式。该方法可表达混合连续分布等以往难以捕捉的分布，并在合成基准和大规模深度强化学习环境中验证。更宽参数族带来的灵活性可转化为性能提升，为分布强化学习提供更通用的建模框架。
papers.abstract_en: Distributional Reinforcement Learning methods aim to learn the entire distribution of returns, yet current algorithmic approaches are limited to a narrow class of distributions. We propose $\varphi$TD, a method to overcome this limitation by computing the loss in the frequency domain. We demonstrate that this further unifies quantile and categorical approaches to distributional RL, and enables the learning of distributions that were previously impossible to capture, such as mixtures of continuous distributions. We empirically study $\varphi$TD, across synthetic benchmarks and large-scale deep RL environments and demonstrate that the flexibility obtained from wider parametric families can lead to improved performance.

papers.title_en: Neural Conditional Gaussian Model: Efficient Data Assimilation with Sequential Uncertainty Quantification for Nonlinear Dynamics
papers.authors: Chuanqi Chen, Nan Chen
papers.evidence: 非线性动力学的潜空间建模与不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 面向部分观测非线性系统的数据同化需反复估计隐状态及其不确定性，传统非线性滤波计算昂贵且依赖显式动力学模型。Neural CGM将物理状态编码到学习潜空间，并在潜空间采用条件高斯动力学实现闭式同化更新。其高斯解码器把潜后验均值和协方差映射回物理空间，结合局部矩传播与非线性修正，使训练与推断共享不确定性统计。基准实验显示状态估计与预测准确，并显著降低在线同化成本。
papers.abstract_en: Data assimilation (DA) in partially observed nonlinear systems requires repeated estimation of both hidden states and their uncertainty. Conventional nonlinear filtering can be computationally expensive and often relies on an explicit dynamical model. In this paper, we develop the Neural Conditional Gaussian Model (Neural CGM), a data-driven dynamical model that maps unobserved physical states into a learned latent space, where the dynamics of the latent states follow a conditional Gaussian structure. This structure allows closed-form DA updates in the latent space, while nonlinear encoder-decoder mappings retain the flexibility needed to represent complex dynamics in physical space. A key feature of Neural CGM is its treatment of uncertainty in DA. The latent posterior mean and covariance are mapped to the physical variables through a Gaussian decoder that combines local moment propagation with learned nonlinear corrections. The resulting physical-space posterior statistics depend on the sequentially updated latent distribution rather than on a separate post-processing estimate. The same statistics enter a Gaussian negative log-likelihood during training, so both the posterior mean and uncertainty affect the learned model. Because Neural CGM learns the dynamical model itself, it can also be used for state forecasting and simulation without explicit knowledge of the governing equations. Numerical experiments on benchmark nonlinear dynamical systems show accurate state estimation and forecasting while substantially reducing online assimilation cost relative to conventional nonlinear DA methods. Neural CGM is therefore suited to repeated state estimation, uncertainty quantification, and prediction from partial observations.

papers.title_en: Grid Cells as Spectral Successor Features: A Reusable Basis for Continual Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Élodie Côté-Gauthier, Doina Precup, Isabeau Prémont-Schwarz
papers.evidence: 基于转移矩阵特征向量的后继特征基用于价值型强化学习
papers.tldr: 持续强化学习需在任务变化时复用环境知识，但后继特征的效果依赖基特征选择。本文以网格细胞为转移矩阵特征向量为设计原则，用固定参考策略的转移矩阵特征向量构造可复用基。由此状态-动作后继特征可写成同点基特征的线性组合，系数为θ_i=1/(1-γλ_i)，无需后继特征网络或回放，适应新任务只需对奖励做线性回归。两目标网格世界中，该方法在每次目标变化后保持近最大回报，而SimpleSF与DQN每次变化损失大部分回报。
papers.abstract_en: Continual reinforcement learning requires agents to adapt when the task changes while reusing what they know about the environment. Successor features separate dynamics from task-specific reward, but their effectiveness depends on the choice of base features. Taking the identification of entorhinal grid cells with eigenvectors of the successor representation as a design principle, we build this basis from eigenvectors of the transition matrix of a fixed reference policy. With such a basis, the successor features at a state-action pair are a linear combination of the base features at that same pair, which is not true in general, and the coefficients are known in closed form: each successor feature is its base feature multiplied by $θ_i = 1/(1-γλ_i)$, where $λ_i$ is its eigenvalue. The long-term return is thus predicted from the same features as the immediate reward, no successor-feature network or replay buffer is needed, and adapting to a new task reduces to a linear regression on the reward. The agent acts greedily on the action values of the reference policy, which is one step of policy improvement over it and suffices to reach a single goal. In a two-goal gridworld, with the uniform random walk as reference policy, whose eigenvectors are the low-frequency Laplacian eigenvectors, agents built this way maintain near-maximal return across every change of goal, whereas SimpleSF and DQN lose most of their return at each change.

papers.title_en: Opto-Electronic Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Based on MZI for Robotic Manipulator Control
papers.authors: Mengting Yu, Shuiying Xiang, Changjian Xie, Yonghang Chen, Haowen Zhao, Xingxing Guo, Zhijian Hao, Yahui Zhang, Yanan Han, Yue Hao
papers.evidence: 基于光电子硬件的机械臂强化学习运动控制
papers.tldr: 机器人机械臂精确控制对边缘部署的实时性与能效要求高，传统电子RL计算开销大、推理延迟高。该文提出基于MZI的光电混合RL架构，将SNN Actor关键线性层映射到光MZI芯片，并采用DDPG-HER与TD3-HER在PyBullet中验证。结果显示在保持控制精度的同时实现1.39 TOPS/W能效和120ps推理延迟。该工作为低功耗高精度机器人控制提供了可行路径。
papers.abstract_en: Precise motion control for autonomous robots is a core technical enabler for the large-scale deployment of embodied intelligence. In particular, basic manipulation tasks, such as point-to-point reaching and target grasping with robotic manipulators, impose stringent requirements on control accuracy, real-time response, and energy efficiency for edge deployment. As a prevailing end-to-end control paradigm, reinforcement learning (RL) has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in autonomous learning and generalization for decision-making in continuous action spaces. Nevertheless, constrained by electronic computing architectures, it generally suffers from substantial computing overhead, high inference latency and limited energy efficiency, making low-power edge deployment challenging. Optical computing, benefiting from its high-speed parallelism, offers a promising route to break energy-efficiency bottlenecks; however, research on the integration of optical computing and RL remains at an early stage. In this work, we propose a Mach-Zehnder Interferometer (MZI)-based opto-electronic hybrid RL architecture. We adopted two algorithm structures: Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient combined with Hindsight Experience Replay (DDPG-HER) and Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient combined with HER (TD3-HER). We implemented the key layer linear computation of the spiking neural network (SNN) Actor on an optical MZI chip for the reaching task of a Franka Emika Panda robotic manipulator. The architecture is evaluated in the PyBullet simulation environment. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed architecture achieves an energy efficiency of 1.39 TOPS/W and an inference latency of 120ps while maintaining control accuracy, which provide a feasible pathway toward energy-efficient and precise control for robots.
